# HONDIT

> HONDIT is the selling and curation brand of a student team in the GTEP programme at Jeju National University (Jeju, Republic of Korea). It introduces StoneJeju Jeju volcanic-stone diffusers to overseas customers (Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan, Taiwan and more) with direct PayPal checkout. StoneJeju (stonejeju.com) makes the diffusers; HONDIT does not manufacture them. HONDIT is not JEJU STONE, HEJDIN or any other Jeju stone brand.
